heading: Ticket types
intro: Unsold ticket types of a draft event can be edited. Hiding a ticket type stops new sales but keeps issued tickets valid. To change a type that has sales, hide it and add a new one to the draft.
editDisabled: Only unsold ticket types of a draft event can be edited
empty: No ticket types yet. Add them from the event draft.

notices.hidden: “{name}” is hidden. Issued tickets remain valid.

hideModal.title: Hide this ticket type?
hideModal.body: “{name}” will no longer be offered at checkout. {count} issued ticket(s) stay valid for admission. You can restore it later if capacity allows.
